findings: Knowledge off selects GENERAL but SendPipeline.admit still appends a durable USER. ChatTurnController.enqueueNew creates CHAT inside atomic draft/send admission. TurnFinalizer persists assistant content and citation records. These paths cannot be reused by toggling retrieval only.

SessionDraftStore intentionally writes encrypted drafts after debounce and flushes at lock; temporary composer must never receive this store or a durable draft key. Preserve existing normal drafts during every mode transition.

SkeinNavCodec serializes canonical ChatKey/NewChatKey identifiers. Temporary routes require excluded transient identity and no restorable transcript, title or content-bearing entry saved state. A disappearing route does not prove no persistence.

ModelServices HIGH lock revokes turns; LOW flushes ordinary answers/drafts, closeSessionState clears app state. Ephemeral work must synchronously revoke then discard without entering durable LOW flush. Stop preserves only memory; errors and model changes must not route through ordinary retry persistence.

Native JNI uses llama_memory_clear(memory,true) for context clearing. This is a useful existing primitive, not evidence that immutable Kotlin/IPC strings or all allocator/device buffers are erased. Instrument cleanup and failure; do not display privacy success on uncertain native cleanup.

proposed_lifetime.owner: Unlocked vault session epoch, separate temporary-session ID and memory-only transcript/composer
proposed_lifetime.rotation: Can retain while same live epoch/controller; no SavedStateHandle or Bundle content
proposed_lifetime.background: Follow existing lock policy; keep visible disclosure that background alone may not immediately lock. On idle/screen-off lock, synchronously revoke publication and discard session.
proposed_lifetime.close_lock_process_death: Discard; relaunch cannot restore. An in-flight native request must cancel/clear or isolated process terminate under established lock backstop.
proposed_lifetime.split_and_spaces: Keep independent temp handles per explicitly owned live Space/session; moving panes is not a save. Reject obsolete callbacks after Space/lifetime change.
proposed_lifetime.copy_or_save: No implicit durable copy. Any later explicit save/export is separately disclosed and intentionally retained; no such action implemented by this review.

verification.host: Spy forbidden persistence interfaces with unique markers including canceled/late callbacks and low-lock finalization; enforce absent navigation serialization and logs.
verification.encrypted_runtime: Inspect real DB tables, derived indexes, files and captured saved state before/after lifecycle events; retain actual XML/JSON/byte receipts. Test marker controls on normal saved chats to show inspection can detect persistence.
verification.physical: App/source/model identities, current connection + normal owner unlock, one synthetic temporary session at a time, saved drafts preserved; physical check remains open.
verification.limits: No claim of universal secure erasure, screenshots/clipboard/keyboards outside boundary, or instantaneous immutable-string zeroization.
